triage.summary: An email claiming to be from Google Workspace says Alex’s password expires in two hours and urges account verification through a suspicious link to avoid suspension.
triage.risk_reason: The sender domain imitates Google with the misspelling “g00gle,” and the message uses an urgent threat of suspension to push a verification link.
